extracted.name: Coffee Butter Frosting
extracted.description: This coffee buttercream frosting is sure to be a favorite for java lovers everywhere. It mixes up quickly and can be used on any type of cake or cupcake.
instruction_lines: Whisk powdered sugar and cocoa powder together in a bowl.

Beat butter in a medium bowl with an electric mixer until creamy, 2 to 3 minutes. Gradually add powdered sugar mixture, beating well after each addition and scraping the sides and bottom of the bowl occasionally. Add coffee and beat until smooth.
